# Clearpath Husky A200 assets

SPAR vendors the A200 base, top-chassis, and outdoor-wheel STL meshes from
Clearpath Robotics' `clearpath_common` repository. They are used as visual
geometry; SPAR supplies its own MuJoCo collision and dynamics model.

- Upstream: https://github.com/clearpathrobotics/clearpath_common
- Source commit: `4c6eae8347e3a002e87249ce8b826b789e5205aa`
- Source paths: `clearpath_platform_description/meshes/a200`
- License: BSD 3-Clause; see [LICENSE](LICENSE)

The files are redistributed without geometric modification. They are renamed
only to keep the local asset names explicit.
